carmen: quick note  saw medium-tail regressions after enabling micro-mini window. p99 for 250-500 token requests climbed.

drew: any correlation with kv cache?

carmen: yes, kv miss rate jumps and mediums often get pushed into later coalesces. shorts keep closing windows.

olga: two paths: (1) add length-aware soft reservations in the continuous batcher, (2) route >=X tokens to an isolated micro-lane.

carmen: prefer hybrid: keep single runtime but pre-reserve soft slots for estimated-large requests when coalesce depth is low. cheap, reversible.

drew: implement per-tenant sliding budget to stop abuse. release reservations after timeout. add metrics: soft_reserves, reserve_releases, kv_evictions_by_class.

telemetry-bot: Canaries queued: batcher/soft-reserve -> pool-5.

olga: ops: ensure a single kill-switch and high-threshold to disable quickly. devs: prototype in bench and capture the new metrics for 48h.

carmen: i'll post a short RFC follow-up capsule describing reserve_hint API and budget model. reconvene after canary. :white_check_mark:
